messages:
maria (docs): Quick FYI: after the latest model swap some embedding examples started producing 256-d vectors instead of 128. Users running our quickstarts hit index errors.
aj (sdk): Ack — which quickstarts?
maria (docs): quickstarts/js/embedding-snippet.md, guides/onboarding/embeddings.md, and a couple of stored sample outputs in the docs site. The smoke tests fail because they assert length==128.
kevin (eng): We bumped the default embed model to v2 for quality. Theres an alias in place but docs still reference the old explicit id in several places.
sara (pm): This is customer visible but not a system outage. We should patch docs + add a short migration note + request a tiny SDK safeguard.
aj (sdk): I can add a guard that throws a clear error if embedding.length != expected. Will add unit test. Proposed snippet: ```js
const e = await client.embeddings.create(...);
if (e.data[0].embedding.length !== 256) {
  throw new Error('Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 256. See: https://redwood/docs/migrate/embed-dim');
}
```
maria (docs): Please paste the exact error text once you have it; I'll use verbatim in the docs so users can search. Also need updated sample output JSON for CI.
aj (sdk): Will open PR in SDK and include test and exact error string. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
kevin (eng): To buy time I'll add a backend alias mapping old_id -> new_v2 for 14 days and add an opt-in legacy projection flag so some customers can keep 128 dims. Backend PR: https://git.redwood/infr/serving/pull/7481 (WIP). Note: alias removal date 2026-04-20 in changelog.
sara (pm): Docs task list: 1) Add top-level migration callout in embeddings.md, 2) Update JS/TS quickstart snippets & expected outputs, 3) Link to SDK error/message and the backend alias/opt-in, 4) Add line in release notes/changelog.
maria (docs): I'll open a WIP docs PR with callout + updated snippets and a failing smoke test to iterate: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/4891 (WIP). Marking as docs/migration.
aj (sdk): SDK PR: https://git.redwood/infr/sdk/pull/2113 (WIP)  includes the check and a unit test. Error message: "Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 256. If you rely on 128-d vectors, see https://redwood/docs/migrate/embed-dim for migration steps"
maria (docs): Got it, copying exact message. I'll update sample outputs and CI assertions to expect 256 where appropriate. Opening CI ticket INF-1729 for smoke test updates.
kevin (eng): I'll coordinate infra to roll the alias earlier if we need an inbound mitigation.
sara (pm): Also consider a short note in the SDK changelog so customers see the thrown error and link.
aj (sdk): Will include changelog entry and a brief migration snippet to convert 128-indexes to 256 (recommend reindexing or zero-pad fallback).
maria (docs): OK—final merge plan: wait for SDK exact string and backend alias PR link, then merge docs PR and update release notes. If alias isn't ready, we'll add a clear note that submissions may break until alias rollout.
docs-bot: Reminder: add labels [docs/migration], [priority/medium] to PR 4891 and link related PRs.
sara (pm): Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with PR links and merge approvals. :thumbsup:
